resources.string: Retry on any model request error
Also retry 401/403 auth errors, 402 quota errors, malformed requests or responses, empty replies and custom provider errors
Network errors, 408/429/5xx and truncated replies are always retried. Checked types are retried in addition to those.
Select all (same as retrying any error)
Heads up: these errors usually need you to fix the API key, balance, model or request format. Retrying keeps sending the same request and keeps using your quota until you stop it.
Expired key, revoked permission, web session expired
Out of credit or over the plan limit
Bad parameters, rejected content, unparsable response
Anything else a provider throws that has no error code
Ignore the retry count above and keep retrying with the configured interval
This can keep spending quota for a long time. Only cancelling the generation or turning off auto retry stops it, and a wrong configuration will never fix itself.
